## Mexico Fantastico, 2027

12 days / 11 nights. Mexico City — San Cristóbal — Palenque — Cancún.

### Price per person

Double occupancy (DBL). Airfares are charged separately.

| Hotel category | USD |
|---|---:|
| 4-star | 4046 |
| 5-star | 5209 |

The programme includes an English-speaking guide. Transfers in Cancún are provided by a Spanish-speaking driver only, without a guide or assistance. These rates are not valid from 27 October to 5 November 2027, during Formula 1 and Day of the Dead festivities.

provenance.rationale: Composes the approved Word title, route, 12-day/11-night programme, guide language and blackout dates with the DBL hotel-category prices found only in the pinned Russian source. Word has no numerical price rows.
